title: Standalone Agent Session Runtime

acceptance_gates.gate_1_session_discoverable_and_inspecta: VERIFIED (Agent Session is discoverable, queryable by workspace/purpose/agent, and fully inspectable with scope, lifecycle, and capsule hash)
acceptance_gates.gate_2_same_agent_works_in_program_and_s: VERIFIED (The exact same registered AgentDefinition binds into ProgramAgentPhaseBindingManifest and StandaloneAgentSession)
acceptance_gates.gate_3_session_has_explicit_authority_sc: VERIFIED (Session scope has explicit, hash-addressed bounds on tools, evidence, and max_invocations budget)
acceptance_gates.gate_4_context_does_not_leak_across_sess: VERIFIED (Context capsules are strictly isolated; cross-session or foreign capsules are rejected fail-closed with SessionContextLeakError)
acceptance_gates.gate_5_session_pause_resume_repair: VERIFIED (Session supports pause, resume, bounded in-session repair with BoundedRepairRuntimeEngine, and completion receipts)

false_proof_defenses.defense_1_debug_session_broader_tools: BLOCKED (Requesting tools outside the agent package raises SessionToolEscalationError)
false_proof_defenses.defense_2_reuse_stale_program_context: BLOCKED (Passing foreign or cross-session capsules raises SessionContextLeakError)
false_proof_defenses.defense_3_session_without_operator_autho: BLOCKED (Invoking a session in CREATED state raises SessionAuthorizationRequiredError)
false_proof_defenses.defense_4_session_writes_canonical_state: BLOCKED (Read-only standalone session attempting state mutations raises SessionCanonicalWriteBlockedError)

concrete_trace_demonstrated.lifecycle_path: Session Start (CREATED) -> Operator Authorize (AUTHORIZED) -> Invocation (ACTIVE) -> Pause (PAUSED) -> Resume (ACTIVE) -> Complete (COMPLETED) -> AgentSessionReceipt

limitations: Standalone session state mutations require explicit governed Operation binding and are read-only by default
